hypothesis: TTM operating cash flow divided by total liabilities measures how comfortably a firm's liability base is covered by cash generated from operations. It is economically distinct from the debt ratio (size of liabilities) and ocf_ni (earnings quality): a low-leverage firm can still have weak cash coverage of its liabilities, and a high-leverage firm can service its liabilities comfortably. Data feasibility audit (no returns inspected): coverage 100% within historical non-financial HS300 members; mean absolute monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation is 0.63419 against debt_ratio_latest and 0.206558 against ocf_ni, both below 0.70. R35 previously found weak quintile IC for ocf_debt, so this round tests whether a full system backtest with quality and cash sleeves produces a different, tradable result.

factor.formula: TTM net operating cash flow divided by total liabilities; higher means stronger cash coverage of the liability base
factor.point_in_time: engine PIT derived factor; effective date is the latest PIT date among cash_flow and balance_sheet dependencies; strictly later than the effective date
factor.missing_policy: no filling, no zero substitution, no fallback to debt ratio, ocf_ni, accrual or cash-flow stability factors

universe.rule: historical HS300 members excluding industry_l1 in {银行, 非银金融}
universe.industry_source: current ext_hy_ths industry snapshot; not historical PIT

control_strategy.purpose: Same non-financial universe, ocf_debt availability filter and execution; ocf_debt is not scored.

execution.universe: historical non-financial HS300 membership; daily snapshots from 2022

samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2022-2026 curve
samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2022-2026 curve

gates.D1: factor coverage within historical non-financial HS300 membership over 2022-2026 is at least 90%
gates.D2: first valid value occurs by 2022-06-30 and recent-12m coverage is at least 95%
gates.D3: mean absolute monthly cross-sectional Spearman correlation is at most 0.70 against both debt_ratio_latest and ocf_ni
gates.G1: discovery 2022-2024 total return is at least control + 5pp
gates.G2: discovery 2022-2024 MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G3: validation 2025-2026 total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G4: full-sample rolling-1y positive rate is at least control
gates.G5: full-sample MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G6: full-sample total return is at least control - 5pp
gates.G7: recent 12m total return is positive and recent 12m MDD is no worse than control by more than 2pp
gates.G9: candidate full-sample total return is at least the R221 SG&A-level candidate full-sample total return minus 5pp

decision_rule: All D and G gates must pass. The factor definition, non-financial universe, scoring weights, holding period and stop loss are frozen before the strategy backtest. No post-result relaxation, filling, industry redefinition, or substitution with prior factors is allowed.
known_limitations: The industry classification is a current snapshot, not a historical PIT industry series.
Financial tables are current snapshots; statutory deadlines are used because provider announcement dates are not reliable first-disclosure timestamps.
Total liabilities include operating liabilities as well as interest-bearing debt, so ocf_debt is a broad coverage measure rather than an interest-coverage ratio.
Financial firms are excluded because operating cash flow and liability definitions are not economically comparable.
R35 found weak quintile IC for ocf_debt; a full system backtest does not erase that prior evidence.
The factor is research-only until every pre-registered gate passes.
